profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at BAE Systems, Inc.
profile.summary: Embedded software engineer with experience in embedded avionics.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Aviation. Automated worst case JSON object file with a Python script which generated standardized testing measures to decide which JSON parser was best suited for the Garmin Integrated Flight Deck project. Experimented with different partition termination on software simulator and hardware with ezTelnet commands to test the hardware reaction. Assembled and executed software and hardware units test and ANTS hardware tests built via Python script for development regulation.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Implemented What's New? feature on iOS and cross-platform for Garmins four automotive applications to constantly check a server for new information about included feature updates. Designed the iOS view using Swift and used the Djini Library to connect to the view model in C++ using Object-Oriented Programming practices to work with Android implementation. Engineered various solutions to bugs and issues in Swift and C++ on JIRA dashboard in between code reviews for other various projects.

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description: Used HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript to create a webpage that displayed needed backlog information that was collected from a server during my winter break.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Visual Studio Code · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · HTML5 · Git

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Research Assistant for the Arizona Twin Project

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description: Worked for OEM Manufacturing company in Laurel, MT that uses microcontrollers to interact with iOS/Android app to increase safety and usability in equipment for installing glass. Developed unit tests on embedded systems. Used Google Tests, Gmock, CMock to test simulator.
positions.insights: Skills: C/C++ · C++ · Unit Testing · C (Programming Language) · Embedded Software · Git

positions.title: Student Mentor
positions.description: I am a mentor at the Youth Leadership Institute at the University of Southern California put on by the Hispanic Scholarship Fund. I work with Hispanic High school students entering their senior year and guiding them along their college selection process.
